notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.1.0
notes.content:
Added function descriptions for each key in the Settings menu.

Introduced a new Tutorial section to help players learn the basics.

Implemented crouch functionality for improved stealth and control.

Adjusted in-game text sizes to improve readability.

Story transitions can now be skipped or continued manually with a key press.

Fixed bugs related to Brightness and Mouse Sensitivity settings.

A confirmation prompt ("Are you sure?") has been added before returning to the Main Menu.
